facts.business: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited is an integrated steel and ferro alloy manufacturer with operations spanning from iron ore to finished steel, captive power, and logistics, and is expanding into stainless steel, aluminium foil for EV batteries, railway wagons, and special bar quality steel for automotive.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Aluminium foil facility catering to EV battery value chain will operate in the current year
Railway wagon manufacturing facility from own metal for national rail network is being commissioned
Special Bar Quality Mill dedicated for auto-grade steel should see light of day in next 2-3 years

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Title deeds of certain immovable properties (freehold land worth Rs 15.84 crore, Rs 9.68 crore, Rs 0.31 crore and leasehold land worth Rs 1.06 crore) are not held in the name of the company but in erstwhile names or third parties; management is yet to get these transferred

key_risks: Title deeds of certain immovable properties not transferred in company's name
Transition risk from commodity steel to specialty/stainless steel and new ventures (aluminium foil, railway wagons, auto-grade steel)
Execution risk on multiple simultaneous capex projects
facts.related_party_note: Title deeds of certain properties are held in names of related parties (Shyam DRI and Power Limited, Bhagwan Shaw, Kamal Lodha) and not yet transferred to the company
